Title: Thanks from John & only 2 unanswrd qstns

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
weld...@postbox.acs.ohio-state.edu (John D. Welday) writes:

>Thanks to everyone who helped me out with my questions, I read all of the
>replies and it really helped!

>The only 2 questions that weren't really confirmed were about the error
>cards and the total number of cards. I decided to post this to see if I got
>any further response.

>How many cards are there officially the highest number I have heard is 438.
>Can Tom or anyone confirm this?

438 is correct.

>Last, if there is no list of the error cards (a complete list) then I
>wouldn't mind putting one together. I would like to get to the bottom of
>this. As a collector I want to know the playing field and since Jyhad
>didn't come with any complete lists can or will the company tell us what is
>out there? Correct and incorrect? If I have to snail-mail someone or call
>them let me know. If there isn't a complete list out there then I will
>start one and everyone can just send me the lists of errors that they know.

Messages.Author: John D. Welday
Messages.Body:
Thanks to everyone who helped me out with my questions, I read all of the
replies and it really helped!

The only 2 questions that weren't really confirmed were about the error
cards and the total number of cards. I decided to post this to see if I got
any further response.

How many cards are there officially the highest number I have heard is 438.
Can Tom or anyone confirm this?

Last, if there is no list of the error cards (a complete list) then I

wouldn't mind putting one together. I would like to get to the bottom of
this. As a collector I want to know the playing field and since Jyhad
didn't come with any complete lists can or will the company tell us what is
out there? Correct and incorrect? If I have to snail-mail someone or call
them let me know. If there isn't a complete list out there then I will
start one and everyone can just send me the lists of errors that they know.

Thanks in advance!

John
